text: マヨちゃん　とこ　あそびに　いこっかなー

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after a verb stem, followed by a verb of going, tells what you are going for. あそびに　いこっ = 'go to play'.

patterns.name: 〜ようかな
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus かな means 'maybe I'll do it', said to yourself. いこっ is a casual clipped form of いこう. いこっかなー = 'maybe I'll go'.
